label: tp4-ring-final-writeback-mhc-post
startup_findings: The XPU extension needs the custom oneCCL library in LD_PRELOAD so its private C hook is globally visible.
Global preload raises the rank-0 startup footprint enough that gpu_memory_utilization=0.95 misses the free-memory gate by about 0.18 GiB; 0.94 starts successfully.
The failed missing-symbol and 0.95-memory attempts are retained beside the passing result directory.
decision: Do not promote or submit. Ring writeback plus MHC-post is exact and graph-safe, but it forces a standalone following MHC-pre while the baseline already fuses MHC-post and MHC-pre. The next viable boundary must fold the following MHC-pre into the ring completion and replace the existing fused post/pre kernel entirely.
